results.text: List the order_status and the number of orders in each status.
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_status, count(*) AS order_count FROM olist.orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_count DESC

results.text: How many orders are there in total? Return a single count.
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) AS total_orders FROM olist.orders

results.text: Among orders whose status is 'delivered', how many have no recorded delivery date? Return a single count.
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) AS delivered_without_date FROM olist.orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL

results.text: How many orders have no rows at all in the order_items table? Return a single count.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM olist.orders o
LEFT JOIN olist.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE oi.order_item_id IS NULL
LIMIT 1000;
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders_without_items FROM olist.orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM olist.order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id)

results.text: List the seller_id and the number of order items sold, for the 5 sellers with the most order items.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT oi.seller_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS num_order_items_sold
FROM olist.order_items oi
JOIN olist.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
ORDER BY num_order_items_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT seller_id, count(*) AS item_count FROM olist.order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY item_count DESC, seller_id LIMIT 5

results.text: List the payment_type and total payment_value for each payment type, highest total first.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    payment_type, 
    SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment_value
FROM 
    olist.order_payments
GROUP BY 
    payment_type
ORDER BY 
    total_payment_value DESC
LIMIT 1000;
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_type, sum(payment_value) AS total_value FROM olist.order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY total_value DESC

results.text: Considering ONLY orders that have a delivery date recorded, what is the average number of days between purchase and delivery? Return a single average.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400) AS avg_days_between_purchase_and_delivery 
FROM 
    olist.orders o 
WHERE 
    o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0) AS avg_days FROM olist.orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

results.text: Considering ONLY orders that have a delivery date recorded, how many were delivered LATER than their estimated delivery date? Return a single count.
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) AS late_deliveries FROM olist.orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

results.text: List the review_score and the number of reviews with that score, from score 1 to 5.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    r.review_score, 
    COUNT(r.review_id) AS num_reviews
FROM 
    olist.order_reviews r
WHERE 
    r.review_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5
GROUP BY 
    r.review_score
ORDER BY 
    r.review_score;
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT review_score, count(*) AS review_count FROM olist.order_reviews GROUP BY review_score ORDER BY review_score

results.text: List the seller_state and the number of sellers in each, for the 5 states with the most sellers.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT s.seller_state, COUNT(*) AS num_sellers
FROM olist.sellers s
GROUP BY s.seller_state
ORDER BY num_sellers DESC
LIMIT 5;
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT seller_state, count(*) AS seller_count FROM olist.sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY seller_count DESC, seller_state LIMIT 5

results.text: How many DISTINCT values does seller_city take? Return a single count.
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT seller_city) AS distinct_cities FROM olist.sellers

results.text: List the product_category_name and the number of products in it, for the 5 categories with the most products.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS num_products
FROM olist.products p
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY num_products DESC
LIMIT 5;
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_category_name, count(*) AS product_count FROM olist.products WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_category_name ORDER BY product_count DESC, product_category_name LIMIT 5

results.text: How many products have no product_category_name recorded? Return a single count.
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM olist.products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL LIMIT 1000;
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) AS uncategorised FROM olist.products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL
